items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: But the basic group was made up of... Irving Ashby on guitar, and myself on piano.

ctx.x: But the basic group was made up of Marshall Royal who played clarinet on the date, and Ray Perry

played violin, and some alto. But primarily Marshall played the clarinet and Ray Perry played the violin, and there was Vernon Alley, the bass player, he was on those records. He hadn't been replaced yet, and there was Lionel on the vibes, and Irving Ashby on guitar, and myself on piano.

And one of those dates was a trumpet player who later on left the group. Karl George. He was a very, very fine first trumpet player with a beautiful tone, who had played with Teddy Wilson's very fine, big band. And he had a beautiful sound. He was instrumental --
